event_sources.description: List of event sources to poll (e.g., calendar feeds or APIs).

interval_minutes.description: How often to poll this source (in minutes).

name.description: Unique name for this source (used in logging and metadata).

query.description: Optional filter query (e.g., CalDAV query string or API parameter).

url.description: URL or path to the event data source (e.g., CalDAV URL or local .ics file).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the service.

recipient_groups.description: List of recipient groups. Each group is addressed by name and sends reminders to all listed recipients.

name.description: Unique name for the group (referenced in event mappings).

recipients.description: List of email addresses for this group.

default_lead_time.description: Minutes before an event to send a reminder by default.

max_lead_time.description: Maximum allowed lead time in minutes (e.g., 1440 = 24 hours) to prevent overly early reminders.

smtp.description: SMTP server configuration for sending emails.

from_address.description: Sender email address shown in 'From' field.

password.description: SMTP password (optional for auth; use secrets manager in production).

default_body.description: Default email body template. Supports Jinja2-style event field interpolation.

default_subject.description: Default subject line. May include {{ event.* }} placeholders.
